title: Level-three book norm growth quantity
statement: For a natural number $d$, define the level-three book norm growth quantity to be $\displaystyle(3d)^{-1/2}(\sqrt{3})^{3d}$, where the first factor is the real power $\operatorname{rpow}(3d,-1/2)$ (and equals $0$ when $d=0$).
